_about: What is owed, as bounded packages with acceptance criteria. Nothing here is built.

packages.title: The v2 engine and the matching fixes inside project-ilm/chakra, beside v1
packages.accept: Chakra's own gate green; v1 core with zero diff; each matching fix carries a test that fails on the old code

packages.title: A C99 twin of the v2 engine
packages.accept: byte parity with the JavaScript engine on the oracle epochs

packages.title: WASM, Kotlin, Swift and Dart bindings through the C twin
packages.accept: each binding reproduces the parity vectors

packages.title: Android and iOS home-screen widgets
packages.accept: a widget shows any countdown card from config/widgets.json

packages.title: f64 lowering in the PANINI WASM back end, then the engine in PANINI
packages.accept: emitted C and WASM pass the same parity vectors

packages.title: A Surya Siddhanta mode beside the drik one
packages.accept: mean and true places per the Burgess translation, selectable in config/schools.json

packages.title: Bengali, Malayalam, Odia and Tamil solar months
packages.accept: each month-start rule retrieved and tested against a published year

packages.title: Ashtakavarga and Shadbala
packages.accept: tables retrieved from a named source; totals tested

packages.title: The full graded yoni table
packages.accept: retrieved from a named source; replaces the partial rule

packages.title: Varjyam, Amrit Kalam and Dur Muhurta
packages.accept: rules retrieved; times tested against a published day

packages.title: Yugadi, Manvadi, Ashtaka, Anvashtaka and Purvedyuh dates
packages.accept: tithi lists retrieved from a named source

packages.title: The Raksha Bandhan second-day rule and the Holika Dahan Bhadra-puccha allowance
packages.accept: rules retrieved; 2026 dates checked against a published list

packages.title: Further ayanamshas
packages.accept: each defined by epoch and value from a named source and measured against the oracle
